Find your flow.

Build: choose Freehand and draw a loop, or Edit points to drag nodes. Tap empty space to add a node; double-click a node to delete. Open Elevation in the top toolbar, select a numbered point and set its height in metres. Switch Session to Rally stage for an open route. Dragging, saving and reversing keep each point’s height. Road & scenery includes a rolling-hills preset that replaces all point heights.

Drive: WASD or arrows. Space handbrake, R recovery, C camera, H horn, M mute, Esc pause. Gamepad: left stick steering, RT throttle, LT brake, A handbrake, Y recover, Start pause. Touch controls appear on mobile.

Laps: pass the checkpoints in order and cross the finish line. Leaving the road slows you down. Recovery invalidates the current lap. The translucent car is your saved personal best.

Formula One sound: recorded generic engine loops follow the uploaded Ferrari script’s 18,000 RPM limit and seven gear ratios. These are not authentic Ferrari recordings. A synthetic fallback is used if sound downloads fail.

Daily run: one deterministic layout per UTC day, in the GT car. Records and tracks are saved only in this browser. There is no global leaderboard or account sync.

This is an independent game with original code and procedural models, not affiliated with Apex Drawn. No paid features. No game exports.

Audio: domasx2 (CC0) and qubodup (CC BY 3.0), processed for looping. Audio sources and licences.
